tldr: The life steers toward the hidden and the transcendent.
meaning: Solitude, the unseen, undoing, and the inner life carry the life. Much happens behind the scenes.
business: Oriented to behind-the-scenes, research, institutions, spiritual or caregiving work.
shadow: Self-undoing, isolation, working unseen and unrewarded.
advice: Put your energy where the chart ruler sits; this is the house your life is asking you to develop.
